preprocessing.description: Fixed geoBoundaries KOR ADM2 2020 source, 228 actual features versus 229 in upstream metadata. Preserve all source coordinates/components/holes and IDs. Only property names and CRS labels are normalized. Source parent codes are absent, so sourceParentId is null. No dissolve, clipping, simplification, snapping, filling, repair or invented boundary. Shared candidate engine performs alignment separately. Distribution license is from geoBoundaries citation/metadata, not inferred from City Population population-data terms.

Retain all 179 original shapeID feature identities and all polygon coordinates/components/holes unchanged. Map shapeName to name; sourceParentId=null because no native ADM1 field is supplied. CRS84 WGS84 values require no numeric conversion. Common pinned generator alone intersects coarse parents. No simplification, snap, repair, synthetic fill, global IDs or publication.
